description: This file defines a collection of error handling functions related to graph resolution and analysis in Spark SQL pipelines, including errors for undefined datasets, unresolved table paths, schema incompatibilities, and schema inference issues.

methods.name: pipelineLocalDatasetNotDefinedError
methods.description: Generates a SparkException when a dataset marked as internal is not defined in the graph.

methods.name: unresolvedTablePath
methods.description: Creates a SparkException indicating that a table path could not be resolved in the catalog.

methods.name: incompatibleUserSpecifiedAndInferredSchemasError
methods.description: Returns an AnalysisException when user-specified schema and inferred schema are incompatible, with special handling for streaming tables.

methods.name: unableToInferSchemaError
methods.description: Returns an AnalysisException when the latest inferred schema for a pipeline table is incompatible with the existing schema.
